Sweat Rate Calculator

Weigh yourself before and after a ride to find out how much you sweat per hour, and how much you should drink on your next ride.

Your ride

Weigh yourself with no clothes (or the same dry clothes) just before and just after the ride, after towelling off. A ride of about an hour at your usual effort works best.

Your sweat rate

See your results

Enter your email to unlock all our free tools and get our newsletter.

How it works

WHY YOUR SWEAT RATE MATTERS

Everyone sweats differently: from under half a litre to more than two litres an hour. Generic advice like “one bottle per hour” can leave one rider short and another drinking far too much. Your own number takes the guesswork away.

The calculation

Fluid lost = weight before − weight after + what you drank − what you passed. One kilo of body weight lost is about one litre of sweat. Divide by the ride time to get your sweat rate per hour.

How much to drink

Aim to lose no more than about 2% of your body weight on a ride: beyond that, performance starts to drop. You don't need to replace every drop, and you should never finish a ride heavier than you started: that means you drank too much.

Test in different conditions

Your sweat rate rises in the heat and at higher intensity. Test on a cool day and a hot day, and at an easy and a hard effort, and you'll know what to drink for any ride. Hot rides also need more salt (sodium) in your bottles.
